from PIL import Image
import numpy as np

img = Image.open('/Users/younes/.wolffish/workspace/uploads/conv-2026-07-01_14-02-19/niepd_logo_black (4).png').convert('RGBA')
data = np.array(img)

# Invert RGB channels only, keep alpha
data[:, :, 0] = 255 - data[:, :, 0]
data[:, :, 1] = 255 - data[:, :, 1]
data[:, :, 2] = 255 - data[:, :, 2]

result = Image.fromarray(data, 'RGBA')
result.save('/Users/younes/Desktop/niepd_logo_white.png')
print('Done')
"
